note: A single back-in dirt site in full sun on a bare clearing just off a state forest road that runs east from PA 144 along the forest's southern boundary toward site SS001. The booking page gives no road name or directions, and the coordinates and Keating plus code in its text belong to a different site about 18 km to the north-east; use the map pin. No table, toilet or water. The agency cautions that it is reached by remote dirt or gravel forest roads that may not suit low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: SS012 still listed, Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle 50 ft, dirt back-in, grades Slight; count 1 and 50 ft confirmed, pull_through false and a sites note added. The page has no road or directions line and its text coordinates point at another site (flag). Season year-round confirmed; sells in all three windows. Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; hookups and facilities none. Imagery (Esri): pin at the south end of a bare dirt clearing about 40 x 60 m on a short spur off a dirt road; not moved. NHD: nothing within 200 m; not waterfront.
flags: PAGE ERROR (agency's, worth knowing): the SS012 page has no 'ROAD LOCATION' or 'SITE DIRECTIONS' line. Its description text gives '41.238840, -77.848440' and 'Google Plus Code: 65Q2+GJM Keating' with 'Apps will not take you directly to this campsite'; that point is about 18 km north-east of the site, where the DCNR GIS layer has SS023 (41.23889,-77.848549) and SS022. The page's own 'GIS Details' (41.1032,-77.9707) and the GIS record SS012 agree with the stored pin, as does the district map, which draws SS012 on a forest public-use road east of PA 144 on the southern forest boundary, west of SS001. The road is not labelled on the map at the site, so no road name is given in the note.
Possible leads, not vetted and not in this batch: GIS records SS022 and SS023 near 41.2389,-77.8485 ('Added December 2024', TrailerAccess 'No').

Agency access statements (ruling 11: nothing measured): 'Caution: This campsite is accessed by remote state forest dirt or gravel roads and may not be suitable for some low-clearance vehicles or large RVs.' 'Site Grade: Slight', 'Driveway Grade: Slight', dirt. No Severe grade, 4WD, wet-weather or clearance statement. Kept. Boilerplate on every Sproul page, not site-specific: 'State forest roads are not maintained in the winter and often become snow covered, icy and potentially impassable' and '4WD vehicles may be recommended for some sites year-round, check notes' (this site's notes say nothing about 4WD).
Figures: 'Length of spur to wheelstop: 20' beside Max Vehicle Length 50, Equipment Length 50, Driveway Length 150, Site 100 x 75. 50 ft kept; the spur figure is in the sites note.
ATV check (ruling 1): nothing on the site page, GIS record or district map places this site in an ATV parking lot. Kept.

Sproul advisories page (read 2026-11-10): no closure or restriction on this site's road; it carries the Bloody Skillet Orviston-lot section closure, the indefinite Left Branch Young Womans Creek Road closure, 'Stay Alert for ATVs on Roads', a dust advisory and a firewood-cutting road list.

NAME: the '(Snow Shoe)' in the stored name is only the booking system's loop label ('Site, Loop: SS012, Snow Shoe').
